source.title: Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 (Act No. 6 of 2014)

source.territorialReferenceNote: CT/OG/Mandal/villages/territorial divisions as on 15 February 2004; municipal wards per Census of India 2001 Report.

limitations: Roster extraction validates serial sequence and selected semantic anchors; it does not prove every extent phrase is semantically complete.
This is a government-hosted Gazette copy; byte identity with India Code is not verified.
The roster is not polygon geometry. Extent-to-polygon validation requires historical administrative-unit geometries and legal provenance.
The ECI 2018 notification and subsequent Gazette/corrigendum chain remain open.
